title: Noncommutative wave-packet obstruction to H-type Schroedinger observability up to the closed-set critical time
difficulty_reason: H3: an ordinary Euclidean coherent state does not supply the required concentration on a compact H-type quotient. The author constructs periodized representation-coefficient packets with central frequency lambda0/epsilon^2 and anisotropic dilated profile, proves uniform scaled Sobolev bounds, and controls pseudodifferential action through operator-valued Taylor remainders and matrix-coefficient orthogonality. The resulting unique rank-one measure, specialized to the first Hermite state, propagates along the slowest central flow. Continuity of each spectral block, preservation of total mass and exclusion of extra character mass then make the observation integral vanish along a ray avoiding closure U. A separate openness-in-time argument includes the endpoint. This new noncommutative counterexample construction and full measure/remainder analysis is the independent core; neither the positivity argument of sufficiency nor an uncounted standard Gaussian statement supplies it.

editorial_notes: Keep exact original author statements, complete proofs and context, with original normalization/source notation. No assistant proof completion, independent correctness certification or formula correction.

M is the left quotient of a connected simply connected H-type group by a discrete cocompact subgroup, with original scalar product and horizontal sub-Laplacian normalization one-half Delta. Keep center dimension p, horizontal dimension2d and homogeneous dimension2d+2p distinct.

H-type GCC follows the central ground-state flow with speed d/2 and lambda/abs(lambda). Horizontal condition A is separate and cannot be dropped: the authors conjecture its removal but do not prove it.
Sufficiency uses analytic potential, open U, condition A and strict T>T_GCC(U). Necessity uses the closure and includes T<=T_GCC(closure U), with no A hypothesis added.
The two geometric thresholds may differ due to grazing rays; no complete iff for the intermediate time interval is claimed.

The selected AppendixC.1 is zero potential and first Hermite h0 on both harmonic slots, with a Schwartz profile and fixed finite physical times. Do not extend it to arbitrary analytic potential, all Hermite harmonics, infinite-time uniform errors or Ehrenfest-scale times.

Original2.10 time-integral norm,4.1 arbitrary-harmonic measure normalization and C.1 S0 displays are retained literally with explicit source observations; no corrected norm, normalization, constant or extra derivation supplied.

Named FF/FF1 operator-valued measures/transport/group calculus, representation theory, compactness, HUM and unique continuation are retained as original inputs. Shared tools/support and stronger unexpanded remarks do not receive additional IDs.
Primary is the author clause(2), with analytic V as in the theorem and no A requirement added. Keep closure U and inclusive endpoint T<=T_GCC(closure U).

The original proof first shows observability at T implies observability at some T-delta, then treats strict avoidance. This is the source endpoint argument; do not replace it with an unsupported packet on a grazing boundary.

Use the author chosen first Hermite h0/h0 for the counterexample, not a new arbitrary-harmonic normalization claim. Proposition4.1 and proof1617 are preserved literally with the normalization observation.

Preserve the no-extra-character-mass argument using full initial/total mass and positive transported ground block; an initial delta description alone is not the complete time-dependent counterexample.
